methods.humidity: Relative humidity from specific humidity, temperature and pressure with the production Teten/Buck formula; coarse native pressure bilinearly interpolated onto the humidity grid before RH derivation.
methods.wind: Earth-relative eastward and northward 10 m components; no grid-angle rotation applied to either side.
methods.selection: Maximum downward shortwave hour at the domain-mid nearest wet model cell, matching the existing weather comparison.
